user.title: Betaloop server
user.description: Same URL and API key as in the Betaloop app (Settings > Analysis server).

data_description.api_key: Key created for Home Assistant with the read scope (POST /api/v1/keys), or the value of BETALOOP_API_KEY in the server's .env file

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Betaloop server rejected the API key (revoked, expired or changed). Enter a valid key with the read scope.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Betaloop
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL or the API key. The new value is checked against the server before being saved.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key. A key with the read scope is enough.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API key.

data_description.scan_interval: The app syncs about every 15 minutes: polling more often than every few minutes brings nothing new.
data_description.history_hours: Hours of readings, doses and meals exposed as attributes for the chart.
